decisions.reason: The candidate already has a complete same-message MODIFY recording the calibrated height study, the endpoint-height-only variable, removal of obsolete length-study attributes, and the rule that the É accent follows the established percentage.
The candidate already has a complete same-message MODIFY replacing the length study with the calibrated endpoint-height progression and removing the obsolete length-related attributes.
The candidate already has a complete same-message MODIFY for the proportional endpoint-height progression, including removal of the superseded reach and length-study attributes.
The source changes only the right-endpoint height study for the two Vs and the later proportional treatment of the É accent; it does not change the E or L letterform requirements.

The proportional endpoint-height study does not replace the existing hierarchy rules: the second V remains subordinate to the Hero V, and only its right arm remains subtly above the E and L cap height.
The source preserves rather than changes the existing exact peak-alignment relationship by requiring the É accent to follow the selected Hero V endpoint-height relationship.
The source isolates endpoint height while preserving all other geometry and does not modify the selected Balanced Flow kerning or spacing rules.
The endpoint-height study does not alter the Satin Reflection finish, champagne-gold distribution, or any other material-treatment attribute.
Only the right endpoints of the Vs are varied; the E and L cap-height rule tied to the second V's left arm remains unchanged.
The source provides design-direction feedback but does not change the independent obligation to include rationale with review rounds.
Changing only the right-endpoint height does not alter the established alignment of both V bottom points with the common wordmark baseline.
The source contains no decision about proof attachment formats or Mac compatibility.
